exposure: N/A (The study aimed to find associations with 'various factors' but did not specify or report on them as exposures linked to outcomes; it primarily described morbidity prevalence).
cohort: The study included 408 antenatal women residing in slums of Guwahati city, Assam.
finding: Among 408 antenatal women, 74% experienced at least one morbidity, with common issues including generalized weakness (59.8%), anemia (59.1%), and nausea/vomiting (52.2%).
cross-section timing: During a 1-year period, assessing morbidities experienced by antenatal women during their current pregnancy.
